name: iSafetyBench
description: iSafetyBench is a video-language benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models in industrial environments, focusing on both routine and hazardous scenarios. It contains 1,100 real-world industrial video clips annotated with multi-label action tags and paired with multiple-choice questions for fine-grained assessment.
reputation: A very recent niche benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest to industrial safety and multimodal evaluation researchers.
notes: Highlights performance gaps in recognizing hazardous activities and multi-label scenarios; dataset publicly available.
